## Procedure

1. Keep back flat and shoulder blades pulled together
2. Lower into a quarter squat position by pushing hips back, flexing knees, letting the torso come forward, and transfer the weight onto the heels (-27)
3. Explosively extend hips and knees and go onto the balls of the feet to accelerate the bar upward
4. Drive the bar upward with the shoulders and arms, and push the body under the bar (-28)
5. In the catch position, the bar should be slightly behind the ears with elbows completely extended and in line with the shoulders and hips
6. Stabilize the body and step feet together so they are shoulder-width apart (-29)
7. Lower the bar to the start position in a controlled manner
